flows.title: Import and accept an attributable graph source

steps.action: Verify source file hash manifest contract and current source-verified human
Begin transaction and derive tenant environment and accountable actor
Insert BUILDING revision with append-only qualified nodes and typed edges
Lock revision and verify current qualifications workload bindings and capacity
Finalize canonical digest through the controlled owner procedure
Commit sealed revision acceptance audit outbox and durable projection work
Return pending projection metadata only

flows.failure: F1 Stop on denied scope, stale evidence, invalid source, lease loss, digest mismatch, store outage or incomplete traversal. No certification or recovery authority is granted.

flows.title: Project an accepted revision across both stores

steps.action: Claim work using the login-bound environment and an expiring lease
Commit lease and export canonical snapshot with digest
Verify canonical bytes protocol identities and projection allowlist
Write nodes relationships and sealed receipt in one managed transaction
Commit exact verified graph or recognize an identical sealed duplicate
Acknowledge the current lease and digest after the Neo4j commit
Mark projected or retain delayed retry after failure or lease expiry

flows.failure: F1 Stop on denied scope, stale evidence, invalid source, lease loss, digest mismatch, store outage or incomplete traversal. No certification or recovery authority is granted.

flows.title: Read dependencies and bounded diagnostic witnesses

steps.action: Submit a verified token explicit graph revision and bounded parameters
Check current identity all workload scopes evidence and projection acknowledgement
Compare sealed receipt watermark counts and full projected content
Return typed topology or calculate direction-aware bounded diagnostic witnesses
Recheck accepted source evidence and acknowledgement before finishing
Return revision-bound scope-limited results with no recovery certification
